name: css_animation_multi
description: PER-PROPERTY CLOCKS: `animation: width 1s linear, opacity 2s linear` is a comma-separated LIST, each entry scoping its own property with its own duration. One diff changes BOTH width (200px -> 40px) and opacity (1 -> 0.5) while DROPPING the animation declaration (old-tree-governs, again): two transitions must run concurrently, the width one finishing at 1s while the opacity one is still mid-flight - transitions counts 2 -> 1 -> 0, and the width measures its linear midpoint and then its final value while opacity is still walking. Scoping is also negative: a property NOT named by any list entry (background) must snap instantly even though other properties are animating.

css: html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
#root { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: row; }
#sidebar { width: 200px; height: 100%; opacity: 1.0; background: #2255aa; animation: width 1s linear, opacity 2s linear; }
